pod_host.text: Welcome aboard! We're rising 138 metres. On a clear day you can see Beachy Head to the east and the Isle of Wight to the west.
Down there, that skeleton in the sea is the old West Pier. We're standing on the spot where its entrance used to be.
The pod is the world's first vertical cable car. Or a very expensive lift with a bar in it. Both are true.

pod_tourist.text: I can see my hotel! And my car. And a traffic warden next to my car.
